mapper.select: SELECT r.RCP_SEQ as rcp_seq, r.RCP_NM as rcp_nm, r.ATT_FILE_NO_MAIN as att_file_no_main, r.INFO_ENG as info_eng, r.RCP_PAT2 as rcp_pat2, CASE WHEN b.BOOKMARK_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_bookmark FROM RECIPE r LEFT JOIN recipe_bookmark b ON r.RCP_SEQ = b.RECIPE_ID AND b.user_id =#{user_id} WHERE r.RCP_NM LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' ORDER BY is_bookmark DESC, r.RCP_SEQ

SELECT r.RCP_SEQ AS rcp_seq, r.RCP_NM AS rcp_nm, r.INFO_ENG AS info_eng, r.INFO_PRO AS info_pro, r.HASH_TAG AS hash_tag, i.ingredient_name AS ingredient_name FROM RECIPE r LEFT JOIN ingredient_detail id ON id.RCP_SEQ = r.RCP_SEQ LEFT JOIN ingredient i ON id.ingredient_id = i.id WHERE r.RCP_SEQ = #{rcp_seq}
